arxiv-2108-02924.title: Interpretable Visual Understanding with Cognitive Attention Network
arxiv-2108-02924.creator: Xuejiao Tang, Wenbin Zhang, Yi Yu, Kea Turner, Tyler Derr, Mengyu Wang and Eirini Ntoutsi
arxiv-2108-02924.description: Abstract While image understanding on recognition-level has achieved remarkable advancements, reliable visual scene understanding requires comprehensive image understanding on recognition-level but also cognition-level, which calls for exploiting the multi-source information as well as learning different levels of understanding and extensive commonsense knowledge.

arxiv-2202-13035.title: Jacobi equations of geodetic brane gravity
arxiv-2202-13035.creator: Riccardo Capovilla ‡ , Giovany Cruz † , and Efraín Rojas
arxiv-2202-13035.description: Abstract We consider brane gravity as described by the Regge-Teitelboim geometric model, in any co-dimension. In brane gravity our spacetime is modeled as the time-like world volume spanned by a space-like brane in its evolution, seen as a manifold embedded in an ambient background Minkowski spacetime of higher dimension.

arxiv-2203-00355.title: Tempera: Spatial Transformer Feature Pyramid Network for Cardiac MRI Segmentation
arxiv-2203-00355.creator: Christoforos Galazis*, Huiyi Wu, Zhuoyu Li, Camille Petri, Anil A. Bharath, Marta Varela
arxiv-2203-00355.description: Abstract Assessing the structure and function of the right ventricle (RV) is important in the diagnosis of several cardiac pathologies. However, it remains more challenging to segment the RV than the left ventricle (LV). In this paper, we focus on segmenting the RV in both short (SA) and long-axis (LA) cardiac MR images simultaneously.

arxiv-2303-01173.title: Resource-Constrained Station-Keeping for Helium Balloons using Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2303-01173.creator: Jack Saunders, Loïc Prenevost, Özgür Şimşek, Alan Hunter, Wenbin Li
arxiv-2303-01173.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jack Saunders, Loïc Prenevost, Özgür Şimşek, Alan Hunter, Wenbin Li. High altitude balloons have proved useful for ecological aerial surveys, atmospheric monitoring, and communication relays. However, due to weight and power constraints, there is a need to investigate alternate modes of propulsion to navigate in the stratosphere. Very recently, reinforcement learning has been proposed as a control scheme to maintain the balloon in the region of a fixed location, facilitated through diverse opposing wind-fields at different altitudes.

arxiv-2304-05479.title: Spatio-temporal fluctuations of interscale and interspace energy transfer dynamics in homogeneous turbulence
arxiv-2304-05479.creator: H. S. Larssen 1, J. C. Vassilicos 2,1
arxiv-2304-05479.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by H. S. Larssen 1, J. C. Vassilicos 2,1. We study fluctuations of all co-existing energy exchange/transfer/transport processes in stationary periodic turbulence including those which average to zero and are not present in average cascade theories. We use a Helmholtz decomposition of accelerations which leads to a decomposition of all terms in the Kármán-Howarth-Monin-Hill (KHMH) equation (scale-by-scale two-point energy balance) causing it to break into two energy balances, one resulting from the integrated two-point vorticity equation and the other from the integrated two-point pressure equation.

arxiv-2501-18236.title: RIS-assisted Physical Layer Security
arxiv-2501-18236.creator: Xudong Li 1 , Matthias Frey 2 , Ehsan Tohidi 1 3 , Igor Bjelaković 1 3 , Sławomir Stańczak 1 3
arxiv-2501-18236.description: Abstract We propose a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted wiretap channel, where the RIS is strategically deployed to provide a spatial separation to the transmitter, and orthogonal combiners are employed at the legitimate receiver to extract the data streams from the direct and RIS-assisted links.

arxiv-2506-08216.title: What makes an Ensemble (Un) Interpretable?
arxiv-2506-08216.creator: Shahaf Bassan, Guy Amir, Meirav Zehavi, Guy Katz
arxiv-2506-08216.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shahaf Bassan, Guy Amir, Meirav Zehavi, Guy Katz. Ensemble models are widely recognized in the ML community for their limited interpretability. For instance, while a single decision tree is considered interpretable, ensembles of trees (e.g., boosted trees) are often treated as black-boxes. Despite this folklore recognition, there remains a lack of rigorous mathematical understanding of what particularly makes an ensemble (un)-interpretable, including how fundamental factors like the (i) number , (ii) size , and (iii) type of base models influence its interpretability.

pmc-10547473.title: Continuous sensing of nutrients and growth factors by the mTORC1-TFEB axis
pmc-10547473.creator: Breanne Sparta, Nont Kosaisawe, Michael Pargett, Madhura Patankar, Nicholaus DeCuzzi, John G Albeck, Ivan Topisirovic

pmc-12732532.title: Evolution Landscape of PiggyBac (PB) Transposon in Beetles (Coleoptera)
pmc-12732532.creator: Quan Wang, Shasha Shi, Bingqing Wang, Xin Chen, Naisu Yang, Bo Gao, Chengyi Song
pmc-12732532.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: The PB family of “cut-and-paste” DNA transposons shows great promise as genetic manipulation tools while significantly impacting eukaryotic genome evolution. However, their evolutionary profile in beetles (Coleoptera), the most species-rich animal order, remains poorly characterized. Methods: A local tBLASTN search was conducted to mine PiggyBac (PB) transposons across 136 coleopteran insect genomes, using the DDE domain of the PB transposase as the query.

pmc-13072895.title: Upcycling Pomegranate Peel into Bioactive Microparticles to Improve Antimicrobial Potential in Apple Juice During Refrigerated Storage

pmc-13072895.description: Unpasteurized fruit juices are prone to microbiological spoilage by bacteria, yeasts, and molds, creating a need for natural preservatives to extend shelf life without compromising quality. Pomegranate peel extract (PPE) exhibits antimicrobial activity primarily against pathogenic microorganisms; however, its effect on spoilage microorganisms in fruit juices has not been previously studied.

pmc-13394964.title: Role of RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL signalling pathway in sepsis‐associated acute kidney injury
pmc-13394964.creator: Huijun Yin, Jingyi Wang, Huirong Han
pmc-13394964.description: Sepsis‐associated acute kidney injury (SA‐AKI) is a common clinical syndrome in critically ill patients, and its high mortality rate is closely related to complex pathological mechanisms. Existing studies have shown that the pathophysiological process of SA‐AKI involves complex multi‐mechanism interactions, including an uncontrolled systemic inflammatory response, abnormal microcirculatory perfusion and disturbed cellular energy metabolism.

uslaw-usc-t10-s7401.title: 10 U.S.C. § 7401 — Members of Army: detail as students, observers, and investigators at educational institutions, industrial plants, and hospitals
uslaw-usc-t10-s7401.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s7401.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part III (Training); Chapter 751 (Training Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary of the Army may detail members of the Army as students at such technical, professional, and other civilian educational institutions, or as students, observers, or investigators at such industrial plants, hospitals, and other places, as are best suited to enable.
